description: List the videos in a video surface, in play order: id, position, label, name, url (the file), content type, size, duration and `link`, the Dock link that opens THAT video. When you point someone at a video, share its `link`, not the surface link: the surface opens on its first video. Omit `surface_slug` for the workspace's first video surface. Viewer role required.

slug.description: The workspace slug. Accepts bare or org-prefixed form.

surface_slug.description: Optional video surface slug. Omit for the first video surface.

name: list_videos
